scope: Coverage and gate index; linked run artifacts contain actual observations, not full hardware acceptance.
threshold_policy: Durations and reconnect counts in online_evidence are proposed sampling targets, not approved acceptance limits. Actual measurements must be reported separately.
result_rule: Only a run record under agv_workspace/acceptance/runs/ may change a device result. Historical evidence and source tests are not current hardware PASS.

safety_state.physical_estop_pressed: User declines pressing; live feedback EmergencyStatus=0. Do not bypass G3.
safety_state.charging_constraint: Do not send nonzero velocity, undock, or change charging state.
safety_state.g3_blocker: Existing stationary handoff requires fresh MCU EmergencyStatus=1; current read-only evidence recorded EmergencyStatus=0.

global_gates.required: Signed assembly inventory: identity, serial/nameplate, wiring, power, mount and purpose for every installed item.
Versioned offline baseline and fault-path tests for each installed driver/protocol.
global_gates.evidence: Selected archived suites pass; camera/BMS/auxiliary driver coverage remains incomplete.

global_gates.required: Current read-only identity, owner, data freshness and evidence capture without control takeover.
global_gates.evidence: 30-second ROS and host inventory collected; scan geometry fails, raw lidar UDP absent, camera gap and cross-host clock offset unresolved.

global_gates.required: E-stop asserted, measured stationary, exclusive ownership, bounded handoff and verified factory recovery.
Approved low-speed functional and failure tests with physical stop measurements.
Every installed required device PASS; no UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, FAIL or unresolved safety incident.
Buildable runtime, launch/config, safety bridge, ownership/recovery and regression entrypoint after G5.

devices.assembly: Current evidence identifies RK3588 as a relay and the internal x86 host; final navigation host and stable topology are unknown.

gaps: No host stress, reconnect, clock or resource test in this bundle.

devices.assembly: Current mapping /dev/rikibase -> ttyUSB1 and robot_driver ownership exists; MCU model/nameplate and auxiliary-field meanings remain unknown.

gaps: No production serial-owner/reactor runner or device-level timeout proof.

conditions.stationary: G3 only: physical E-stop asserted, emergency=1, zero raw speeds, one owner; stationary probe is not offline and is currently blocked.
conditions.dynamic: No dynamic MCU test before G3 and signed G4 plan.
conditions.charging: zero-command only; do not undock or alter charge state.

devices.assembly: Drive/encoder feedback is implied by current driver_info and wheel_odom, but motor, driver, brake and encoder identities/specifications are not closed.

commands: python3 navigation_runtime/replacement/chassis/verify_feedback_units.py  # requires Unicorn and pyelftools; writes archival report
gaps: no brake or physical encoder calibration

online_evidence: external stop distance/time and thermal/current evidence

conditions.stationary: Do not arm; verify only feedback and E-stop interlock under G3.
conditions.dynamic: G4 requires signed speed/space/stop thresholds and each wheel, straight, turn, fault and restart tests.

devices.assembly: Emergency, motor-free, charge, shutdown and alarm fields are decoded from one reviewed frame profile; physical circuits and auxiliary meanings are not confirmed.

gaps: No physical emergency, brake, cable-loss, host-death or lock-wheel proof.

online_evidence: fault latch and manual reset trace

conditions.stationary: Fresh asserted physical E-stop is mandatory for serial handoff.
conditions.dynamic: G4 only: separate tests for E-stop, lock, alarms, task expiry, process death and serial/USB loss.
conditions.charging: Remain stationary; do not use charging as an interlock test.

devices.assembly: Vehicle is reported on its charging dock; battery/BMS/charger/contacts identities, ratings and physical wiring are unknown. Power=82 and ChargeStatus=1 are display fields, not validated SOC/charge proof.

coverage: Recovered charge-controller software differential comparisons; not battery/BMS hardware
gaps: No local battery/BMS/charger driver or electrical charging fixture test exists.

online_evidence: manual charge-state transition evidence and fault/recovery evidence

conditions.stationary: Only passive/current-safe observation until ratings and procedures are confirmed.
conditions.dynamic: G4 motion testing occurs off dock only after an approved undock procedure.
conditions.charging: Current state: no nonzero velocity, no undock, no automatic recharge action.

devices.assembly: A current /scan stream and historical captures support an installed 2D lidar; LT-R2-B label and installation/optics remain unconfirmed until nameplate inspection.

coverage: per-channel age/skew and reversed receipt clock

The new acceptance/incidents/ledger.json is a separate test ledger, not the missing production runtime. No full ROS2 package can be built or accepted.
